note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual content of the transcript and the differential diagnosis (DDx) JSON. Please provide:

- The full transcript (doctor-patient dialogue)
- The DDx in JSON format

What I will deliver after receiving them:

Subjective:
- Current issues, reasons for visit, and history of presenting complaints (onset, duration, progression)
- Past medical history, surgeries (if applicable)
- Medications
- Social history (if applicable)
- Allergies

Objective:
- Physical examination findings (state, side, site, and relevant details)
- Vitals and system-specific findings (if provided)
- Investigations and results (if provided)

Assessment & Plan:

1. [Issue/Diagnosis 1 name only]
   - Assessment
   - Differential diagnoses (from DDx only if consistent with transcript; include “conflict noted” if applicable)
   - Investigations planned (if any)
   - Treatment planned (if any)
   - Referrals (if any)

2. [Issue/Diagnosis 2 name only]
   - (same structure as above)

3. [Additional issues as applicable]

Quality checks (included at bottom):
- Missing but clinically expected elements (e.g., allergies, meds reconciliation)
- Internal conflicts between transcript and DDx (mark “conflict noted”)
- Brief comment on transcript quality if noisy/inaudible

Notes:
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the name and add “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- Use American English, concise, professional tone.
- Do not introduce facts beyond what is present in the transcript or DDx.

Please paste the transcript and the DDx JSON, and I will generate the complete structured SOAP note.
